segments.en: Rabbi Nachman’s Stories of Ancient Times are holy story-tales that clothe very lofty Torah teachings in simple narratives, so every soul can draw close to Hashem through them.
Rabbi Nachman said that within these stories are hidden allusions to very lofty matters, and that through his stories he can awaken and return the world to Hashem.

Go out and see the might of your Master, Who has illuminated heavenly Torah for us through tzadikim in every generation, clothing the King’s treasure houses in stories according to the generation and the times.
